# `sec_rulemakings`

**Selected SEC rulemaking observations**

One selected rulemaking observation, retaining the source file number, title and comment-list discovery basis.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Complete selected retained rulemaking and comment-resource observations. Listing roles and discovery basis remain distinct; broader publisher coverage and current publisher state require separate evidence. *(measured 2026-10-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `sec_rulemakings.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.
